name: game-play-route
goal: Generated 2D and 3D games serve the playable /game route while game.json remains importable

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The generated project has a root game.json. Vite resolves extensionless /game to that module before SvelteKit handles its playable route.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing CLI scenarios validate generated files without starting Vite. Extend both dimension cases to launch the generated app and require a canvas in its /game HTML; retain the standalone saved-image browser scenario.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed baseline 586caf35 reproduces the missing canvas on the second /game request for both dimensions, with paired immutable output and a browser screenshot of the raw module.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: The separate 5dbc84de repair excludes implicit JSON extension resolution in generated game Vite configs while retaining explicit game.json imports.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
